suppress-failure-notify.description: Suppress the failure Slack notification (used for PR rehearsals where failures should not page).

has-src-dir.description: Whether the package has a src directory

skip-check-manifest.description: Skip check-manifest validation. Use for repos that intentionally exclude dev tooling (`.claude/`, `docs/`, `docker/`, …) from the sdist without maintaining a `[tool.check-manifest] ignore` block.

wheel-content-ignore.description: Comma-separated check-wheel-contents codes to ignore (e.g. "W002,W004,W009"). W002+W004 are common no-ops; add W009 for repos that ship multiple top-level packages in one wheel.

custom-container.description: Custom container to use for the build

runner.description: Runner to use for the build

no-build-isolation.description: Do not build the package in isolation

root-dir.description: Navigate into a sub-directory (mind the / at the end)

container-options.description: Options to pass to the container

build-wheel-env.description: JSON object of non-secret string environment variables to export for the wheel build

extra-no-build-isolation-packages.description: Space-separated list of extra packages to pre-install before building with --no-build-isolation (e.g. "grpcio-tools protobuf")
